nodes.description: Public state variable dai initialized to 10**18, exposed as a reserve value by the pair-like contract.
Public state variable tree initialized to 10**18, exposed as the second reserve value.
Public view function getReserves that returns fixed reserve values taken from the dai and tree state variables plus a hardcoded timestamp.
Named return variable _reserve0 assigned from state variable dai.
Named return variable _reserve1 assigned from state variable tree.
Named return variable _blockTimestampLast set to the hardcoded constant 100000 inside getReserves.

edges.reason: State variable dai is read inside getReserves to produce the returned reserve value.
State variable tree is read inside getReserves to produce the returned reserve value.
Value of state variable dai flows into the named return variable _reserve0.
Value of state variable tree flows into the named return variable _reserve1.
Assignment to _reserve0 executes within the body of getReserves.
Assignment to _reserve1 executes within the body of getReserves.
Assignment of the constant 100000 to _blockTimestampLast executes within getReserves.

normalization_plan.reason: Return variable _reserve0 only exists inside getReserves and carries no independent security semantics.
Return variable _reserve1 only exists inside getReserves and carries no independent security semantics.
Return variable _blockTimestampLast is assigned a literal inside getReserves and carries no independent security semantics.
